# EVALUATION RESULTS

`Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct` base vs the same model with the QLoRA adapter, on the
held-out test split (40 examples). Greedy decoding, fixed seed, identical
system prompt — the two columns differ only by the adapter.

Generated by `src/evaluate.py`. Metrics follow the two-tier split in SCOPE.md §5.

## Interpretation

**Fine-tuning bought format and technique compliance, not analytical ability.** The
two largest movements are format adherence (30.0% → 100.0%) and technique-ID accuracy
(2.5% → 90.0%), and both are the same underlying win: the base model had never seen this
report contract, so it invented its own structure — 28 of its 40 reports inject `###`
sub-headings inside the required sections — and it guessed technique IDs essentially at
random, landing on the deprecated `T1086` seventeen times. The adapter taught it the
contract. ROUGE-L more than doubled (0.2416 → 0.5104) and BERTScore rose 0.815 → 0.910,
which is consistent with the same cause: the tuned outputs are shorter (median 381 → 324
tokens) and stop hedging, so they overlap the reference far more closely. Severity went
47.5% → 82.5%, but note the base model scored *below* its own majority baseline (66.0%),
because it under-called `Critical` as `High` twelve times; the tuned model's +16.5 points
over baseline is a real but far more modest gain than the technique number suggests.

**Grounding did not improve, and slightly regressed.** Both variants leave 95.0% of
reports free of invented entities, and the tuned model's ungrounded *entity* rate is
marginally worse (2.1% → 3.4%) because it names more entities per report. Fine-tuning
on grounded references did not teach grounding — the base model was already mostly
grounded, and the headroom was small enough that the adapter had nothing to learn. This
is the honest reading: the primary claim the project set out to support (grounded,
well-formed, readable reports) is carried by *format* and *quality*, not by a measurable
reduction in hallucination.

**Two limitations already logged, restated so these numbers are read correctly.** First,
the synthetic-telemetry loop (`TEMPLATING_DESIGN.md` §7.1): every blob was produced by
our own generator, and a bag of `event_type` n-grams recovers the technique 89.8% of the
time from structure alone against a 17.4% baseline. The 90.0% technique accuracy above
therefore cannot be separated from that structural leak, and must not be read as a
detection result — it is a format-compliance signal, which is why SCOPE.md §5.2 files it
as secondary. Second, the teacher-model ceiling (`DATA_SURVEY.md` §3.3, §3.5): the
references were written by `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` against a hand-curated 21-row
technique lookup, so the tuned model is being scored on agreement with a teacher and a
labelling table of our own construction. Its ceiling is their quality, and systematic
errors in either are invisible to every metric in the table above.
